label: Tripo
description: Tripo AI (studio.tripo3d.ai) API — text/image/multi-view to 3D, text/image to picture, texture, retopology, smart UV, segment and complete parts, convert, LEGO/voxel stylize, auto-rig and animate. Agent tools plus workflow nodes; import into Blender or UEFN.

settings.sections.title: Tripo
settings.sections.description: Paste your Tripo API key (developers.tripo3d.ai → API Keys, starts with tsk_). Stored encrypted on this device. Powers the tripo_* tools and the Tripo workflow nodes. 1 credit = $0.01; buy credits at developers.tripo3d.ai → Billing.

properties.label: API key
properties.description: Get a key at https://developers.tripo3d.ai — Test shows your credit balance.

settings.sections.title: Defaults
settings.sections.description: What Tripo tools and nodes use when a call or node doesn't pick its own.

properties.label: 3D model
properties.description: v3.1 is Tripo's best quality; P1/P2 make clean low-poly game assets.

steps.title: Paste your API key
steps.body: Create a key at developers.tripo3d.ai → API Keys (tsk_…), paste it here, then hit Test to see your credits. Tools appear as tripo_* once this plugin is on.

steps.title: Generate anything
steps.body: Ask a ducky for a model, character or picture, or open Workflows: the Tripo group has Text/Image/Multi-view to 3D, Texture, Retopology, Smart UV, Segment, Convert, Stylize, Auto Rig and Animate. Paid steps only run with Spend credits on, and agents ask you first.

nodes.label: Tripo Text to 3D
nodes.description: A textured 3D model from your prompt on Tripo (v3.1, or P1/P2 for clean low-poly). About 20 credits textured.

nodes.label: Tripo Image to 3D
nodes.description: A 3D model from one picture on Tripo. About 30 credits textured.

config_fields.label: Clean up a low-quality picture first

nodes.label: Tripo Multi-view to 3D
nodes.description: A 3D model from 2–4 pictures of the same thing (front plus sides/back), or the views of a Tripo Image to Multi-view node. About 30 credits.

nodes.label: Tripo Image to Splat
nodes.description: A Gaussian splat (photo-like 3D capture, not a mesh) from one picture.

nodes.label: Tripo Text to Image
nodes.description: A picture from your prompt (Seedream, Banana, Chat Image) — concept art or the picture for Image to 3D. 5–20 credits.

nodes.label: Tripo Edit Image
nodes.description: Changes a picture the way your prompt says, or by a template (T-pose, ready for 3D, variants). More pictures can be wired as references.

nodes.label: Tripo Image to Multi-view
nodes.description: Front, left, back and right views from one picture, for Multi-view to 3D. About 10 credits.

nodes.label: Tripo Edit Multi-view
nodes.description: Changes some views of a Tripo multi-view set by prompt (one prompt per view). About 5 credits per view.

nodes.label: Tripo Texture Model
nodes.description: Paints a model (Tripo's or any GLB/FBX/OBJ) from a prompt, a style picture or a reference picture. 10–30 credits.

nodes.label: Tripo Retopology
nodes.description: Clean, game-ready low-poly topology with the textures baked on (500–20,000 triangles or 500–10,000 quads). 10–40 credits.

nodes.label: Tripo Smart UV
nodes.description: New clean UVs (up to 80k triangles) with the textures re-baked onto them, plus a picture of the UV layout. About 20 credits.

nodes.label: Tripo Segment Parts
nodes.description: Splits a model into parts (v2.0 names them). Wire into Complete Parts to close the hidden sides. About 40 credits.

nodes.label: Tripo Complete Parts
nodes.description: Fills in the hidden and open sides of segmented parts so each is a whole piece. 30–50 credits.

nodes.label: Tripo Convert
nodes.description: Turns a model into FBX, GLTF, OBJ, USDZ, STL or 3MF, with an FBX preset, pivot at the bottom, scale or fewer polygons. 5 credits (10 with options).

nodes.label: Tripo Stylize
nodes.description: Remakes a Tripo model as LEGO, voxels, Minecraft blocks, voronoi, a keyring, fridge magnet or keycap.

nodes.label: Tripo Rig Check
nodes.description: Free: whether a model can be rigged and which skeleton fits (biped, quadruped, avian…).

nodes.label: Tripo Auto Rig
nodes.description: Adds a skeleton and skin to a character or creature (Auto picks the skeleton with a free rig check). Unreal spec = UE mannequin bones. About 25 credits.

nodes.label: Tripo Animate
nodes.description: Animations for a model from Tripo Auto Rig (idle, walk, run, jump, dance_01, wave_goodbye_01…; one model per animation). About 10 credits each.

nodes.label: Tripo Balance
nodes.description: Free: how many Tripo credits are left and how many running jobs hold.

templates.label: Tripo: prompt to 3D model in UEFN
templates.description: Prompt → textured 3D model (Tripo v3.1) → origin at the bottom center → imported into your open UEFN project. Turn on Spend credits on the Tripo steps before the first run.

config.value: A stylized treasure chest, game-ready prop

templates.label: Tripo: picture to 3D model in UEFN
templates.description: One picture → 3D model (Tripo) → origin at the bottom center → into UEFN. Turn on Spend credits on the Tripo steps before the first run.

templates.label: Tripo: prompt → rigged, animated character → UEFN
templates.description: A character from your prompt, auto-rigged (the free rig check picks the skeleton), animated (idle, walk, run) and imported into UEFN as FBX. Turn on Spend credits on the Tripo steps before the first run.

config.value: A cartoon duck adventurer, full body, A-pose, game character

templates.label: Tripo: prompt → concept → 4 views → 3D model
templates.description: A concept picture from your prompt, turned into front/left/back/right views, then one 3D model from all four (best shape from every side). Turn on Spend credits on the Tripo steps before the first run.

config.value: A cute robot mascot, full body, plain background

templates.label: Tripo: make any model game-ready
templates.description: Pick a model: clean low-poly retopology (8,000 triangles, smart UVs, textures baked), origin at the bottom, then into UEFN. Turn on Spend credits on the Tripo steps before the first run.

templates.label: Tripo: repaint a model
templates.description: Pick a model and describe a look; Tripo paints it again with PBR textures. Turn on Spend credits on the Tripo steps before the first run.

templates.label: Tripo: prompt → LEGO-style model
templates.description: A model from your prompt, remade out of LEGO-style bricks (switch Style to voxel or Minecraft in its details). Turn on Spend credits on the Tripo steps before the first run.

config.value: A small castle with two towers
